summary: The ansible.builtin.winrm connection plugin runs commands and file transfers on Windows via WinRM, and accepts extra protocol options as ansible_winrm_<option> variables.
questions: How does Ansible connect to Windows hosts?
How do I pass extra pywinrm options not listed in the winrm plugin docs?

answer_card.title: winrm connection plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.winrm` runs commands and put/fetch on Windows targets over WinRM. Extra protocol arguments not explicitly documented can be passed as variables named `ansible_winrm_<option>`.
